title: 第160章 孙立山被抓第159章 贺远书的能力
slug: 绑定全国每人每天给我一两银
lines: 刺史府。
马谦在宴会结束后，就马不停蹄找到了田世安，将先前发生的事情仔细汇报。
“本官知道了，下去吧。”田世安垂眸开口。
等其离开，才抬起头，眸光深沉。
“好你个云王，竟然开始拉拢士族了。”他喃喃开口，声音带着冷意。
他很清楚对方的举动就是开府在准备。
毕竟一旦开府，朝廷虽会委派属官，但底下的人还是要从本州征辟。
如今诛妖军大胜，云王名声再涨，这些士族恐怕真的会动摇。
想到这，田世安神情冷峻，愈发不安。
现在还不确定那核心账本在不在赵文渊那，如今陆舟又渐渐起势，自己不能坐以待毙。
就在他思索该如何反制之际……
忽然，一道黑影趁着夜色来到房中。
“大人！”那人一身黑衣，只露出双眼，声音低沉。
“探到什么了？”田世安沉声询问，语气期待。
上次，他从儿子那要来了一批探子，之后就一直在暗中监视陆舟。
只可惜，先前迟迟没有结果。
现在对方现身，绝对是找到了什么。
“回禀大人，我们探听到消息，明日孙立山会去一趟黎平县帮云王处理公务。”探子道。
闻言，田世安眼睛骤亮，强压激动：“此事当真？”
如果说云王是自己的头号敌人，那孙立山就是第二号。
正因为有这家伙，所以自己诸多计划才没办法得逞，如今若有机会，一定要找机会拿下！
“千真万确，那孙立山甚至已经开始收拾行李，打算趁夜出发。”探子道。
田世安嘴角一扬：“太好了。”
他陡然起身，双手撑在桌上，神情严肃：“去通知黄崖，随便给孙立山罗织一个罪名，将他抓起来！”
“记住，这一次必须关得严实些，不能让那云王有机会营救！”
只要抓住孙立山，那就相当于断了云王一臂。
甚至可以借孙立山之口，散布假消息、动摇云王内部的军心。
到时候，那些想要倒戈的士族看到云王连核心幕僚都护不住，绝对不敢倒向对方。
“明白。”探子拱手告退。
田世安坐回原处，想到能将孙立山拿捏在手里，不由心中得意。
天光渐亮。
官道上，李雄带着一支三十名王府亲兵组成的护卫，正护送着一辆马车朝北行进。
马车里，孙立山掀开车帘，看着那旭日东升，嘴角微扬。
新的棋局，又开始了！
希望田世安能反应快点。
正想着，后方忽然传来一阵嘈杂的声音，尘土飞扬。
content_en:
Governor's Mansion.
After the banquet, Ma Qian found Tian Shian without stopping and reported in detail what had happened previously.
"I understand, please go down." Tian Shi'an lowered his eyes and said.
After he left, he raised his head with deep eyes.
"Well, you, King Yun, have actually started to win over the nobles." He murmured, his voice cold.
He knew very well that the other party's actions were preparations for Kaifu.
After all, once the government is established, although the court will appoint subordinate officials, the people below will still have to recruit from the state.
Now that the demon-slaying army has won a great victory and King Yun's reputation has increased, these nobles may really be shaken.
Thinking of this, Tian Shi'an looked grim and became increasingly uneasy.
It is still uncertain whether the core ledger is with Zhao Wenyuan. Now that Lu Zhou is gradually gaining momentum, he cannot sit still and wait for death.
Just as he was thinking about how to counterattack...
Suddenly, a black shadow came into the room under the cover of night.
"Sir!" The man was dressed in black, with only his eyes exposed, and his voice was low.
"What did you find?" Tian Shi'an asked in a deep voice, with an expectant tone.
Last time, he hired a group of spies from his son, and they have been secretly monitoring Lu Zhou since then.
It's a pity that there has been no result before.
Now that the other party shows up, he must have found something.
"Reporting to your lord, we have heard the news that Sun Lishan will go to Liping County tomorrow to help King Yun handle official affairs." The spy said.
Hearing this, Tian Shian's eyes suddenly brightened, and he suppressed his excitement: "Is this serious?"
If King Yun is his number one enemy, then Sun Lishan is his number two.
It is precisely because of this guy that many of my plans cannot succeed. If there is a chance now, I must find a chance to win it!
"It's absolutely true. Sun Lishan has even started packing his luggage and plans to set off at night," the spy said.
Tian Shi'an raised his lips: "That's great."
He stood up suddenly, put his hands on the table, and said with a serious expression: "Go and notify Huang Ya, and make any accusation against Sun Lishan and arrest him!"
"Remember, we must lock it up tighter this time, and don't let King Yun have a chance to rescue!"
As long as Sun Lishan is captured, it is equivalent to breaking King Yun's arm.
You can even use Sun Lishan's mouth to spread false news and shake the military morale within King Yun.
When the time comes, those nobles who want to defect will never dare to defect to the other party when they see that King Yun cannot even protect his core staff.
"Understood." The spy bowed his hands and resigned.
Tian Shi'an sat back down, feeling proud at the thought of being able to hold Sun Lishan in his hands.
…
The sky is getting brighter.
On the official road, Li Xiong was escorting a carriage heading north with an escort of thirty royal soldiers.
In the carriage, Sun Lishan opened the curtain and looked at the rising sun with a slight smile on his face.
A new chess game begins again!
I hope Tian Shian can respond quickly.
Just as he was thinking about it, there was suddenly a loud noise and dust flying from behind.
